$comment: Generated by tools/space-shape.mjs: the space roles in the loose option, for [data-space='loose']. Never edit by hand.

stack-pair.$description: Stacked pair that reads as one: label and field, title and subtitle (loose space)

stack-row.$description: Between rows of a list whose rows carry their own fill (navigation items, menu items), so two fills never touch (loose space)

stack-item.$description: Stacked items in one group (loose space)

stack-group.$description: Groups within a section; fields in a form (loose space)

inline-pair.$description: Side-by-side pair: icon and label (loose space)

inline-item.$description: Items in one row: buttons in a group (loose space)

inline-group.$description: Groups in a row: toolbar groups (loose space)

inset-xs.$description: Inside a compact group, around each member’s fill: a segmented control (loose space)

inset-sm.$description: Inside compact containers: menus, list rows (loose space)

inset-md.$description: Inside cards, popovers and panels (loose space)

inset-lg.$description: Inside dialogs, sheets and page regions (loose space)

gutter.$description: Between columns and regions of a layout (loose space)

margin-page.$description: Content to window edge on small screens (loose space)
